name: Beat Haptics
author: DanyFy Audio Lab
description: Feel every beat drop and vocal hook in exact sync with the music: multi-band Rust bass + center-vocal haptic engine.
changelog: v1.1.0: Rhythm-locked Bass + Vocals detection, AudioTrack hardware buffer latency sync, real-time tempo tracking, and strict anti-spam gating.

welcome.message: Beat Haptics v1.1.0 is active! Vibrations are now latency-synced to the speaker and separate bass kicks from center vocals.
steps: Bass kicks deliver firm low-end thumps while exposed center vocals pulse lightly so you can tell bass from singing.
Open Settings → Extensions → Beat Haptics to pick Bass + Vocals, Bass Only, or Vocals Only, and toggle Strict Rhythm Lock.
